stemMd: A town's recycling rate rose from forty to fifty percent. An official says the amount of waste sent to landfill must therefore have fallen. Which possibility has been overlooked?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The recycling rate can be expressed as a fraction.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Landfills are sometimes located outside towns.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Total waste production may have increased enough that the unrecycled amount also increased.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Recycled material can have several uses.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Some residents recycle more than others.

explanationMd: A percentage does not fix an absolute amount. If waste production grows substantially, fifty percent of the new total can exceed sixty percent of the old total. The conclusion requires information about the changing denominator.

distractorRationale.b: Location does not determine the quantity sent.
distractorRationale.d: Uses do not determine the amount left unrecycled.
distractorRationale.a: Changing notation does not affect the inference.
distractorRationale.e: Individual variation does not establish the missing total.
